tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & CCv2 | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Pure SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, CCv2 deployment cycles, Backoffice, OMS, DataHub, Solr, and PIM/ERP integrations. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer holding valid German work authorization, available from 16 December 2026.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Hybris Developer - Kranti Chavan
cover_en.hook: With over 5 years of hands-on experience building, extending, and supporting enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am writing to apply for the SAP Hybris Developer role. As an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring Framework, OCC REST APIs, and CCv2 cloud operations.

bullets.label: Core SAP Commerce & Java Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented core backend functionality on Hybris 2211 using Java and Spring, covering product catalogs, promotions, backoffice, pricing, and OMS while following platform best practices.

bullets.label: CCv2 Cloud Operations & CI/CD
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), managing external integrations, Groovy administrative scripts, and HAC administration.

bullets.label: Headless APIs & Integrations
bullets.text: Engineered and exposed OCC REST Web Services for headless commerce and progressive web applications, alongside robust DataHub, Hotfolder, and PIM/ERP integration pipelines.

bullets.label: Performance & Production Stability
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced transaction latency, configured Apache Solr indexing, and resolved complex production integration issues across international teams.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit (no sponsorship required). I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day of 15 December 2026, making me available for start from 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical expertise can support your team.

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to this opportunity because of your focus on dedicated SAP Hybris platform excellence and cloud-native commerce architecture. Having spent over 5 years developing complex e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (2105/2211) and executing releases on CCv2 for international enterprise clients, I am eager to apply my Java, Spring, and headless API engineering skills to strengthen your delivery team.
tailoring.motivation_short: As an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of Java and Hybris experience, I bring proven skill in CCv2 deployments, OCC REST APIs, and core platform engineering. I am eager to deliver scalable e-commerce solutions for your team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Ms Dahule, as an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of Java/Spring experience on Hybris 2105/2211 and CCv2, I am very interested in your SAP Hybris Developer opening. I hold a valid German work permit and am available from 16.12.2026.
tailoring.offer: In my first months, I will contribute immediately to core Java/Spring developments, OCC REST API engineering, and CCv2 deployment management across your e-commerce platforms. My background in resolving PIM/ERP integration bottlenecks and optimizing database queries will ensure rapid onboarding and platform reliability.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Pure SAP Hybris Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Ms Dahule,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the SAP Hybris Developer role. I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise solutions on Hybris 2105 and 2211 using Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, and CCv2.

Having executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2 and integrated PIM, ERP, and MDM pipelines at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I offer immediate production value to your engineering team. I hold a valid German work permit and am available from 16 December 2026.

My CV and cover letter are attached for your review.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
